scenes.text: POWER SLAP SHOWDOWN debuts. A man named 'Big Hands' Doug was slapped unconscious in round one and woke up speaking fluent Portuguese. Ratings: enormous. Doctors: furious.

choices.label: Expand it to weekly shows
choices.result: Weekly slaps. Your MMA fans write long, angry essays. Then they watch.

choices.label: Keep it to a quarterly special
choices.result: Quarterly. A controlled amount of slapping.

title: The Slap Heard Round the World

scenes.text: A slap fighter has been hospitalized after taking 'the slap of the century'. He's going to be okay. The video has 200 million views. A senator is calling slap fighting 'the end of civilization'. The slap league just outrated your last MMA PPV.
scenes.speaker: Slap promoter Dusty

choices.label: Go all in on slapping
choices.result: You announce a 'Slap World Championship'. Your MMA roster feels quietly betrayed.

choices.label: Add medical rules and slow down
choices.result: Mandatory neurologists. Fewer KOs. Fewer views. More sleep.

choices.label: Shut it down
choices.result: Slap league over. Dusty slaps himself goodbye.

scenes.text: The board notes that the slap league now generates more profit than MMA with 4% of the cost. They propose 'transitioning the brand'. They have prepared a PowerPoint. Slide 1 is a hand.
scenes.speaker: The Board
scenes.title: MEMO: STRATEGIC PIVOT

choices.label: Pivot to slapping full time (this ends your career here)
choices.result: You become the King of Slaps. History will judge you. History is also watching.

choices.label: Refuse. MMA is the business.
choices.result: You give a speech about 'real fighting'. The board writes 'sentimental' in your file.

scenes.text: Episode 3 of the reality show: a contestant threw a couch into the pool, two others got into a fight over a yogurt, and one guy has been hiding in a closet for two days 'visualizing'. The producers are thrilled.

choices.label: Let the cameras roll
choices.result: Ratings up 40%. The yogurt has its own fan page.

choices.label: Bring in a coach to restore order
choices.result: Order is restored. Ratings dip. The coach gets thrown in the pool anyway.

scenes.text: The reality-show finale: the two finalists are the guy who threw the couch and the guy from the closet. The winner gets a contract with {promotion}.

choices.label: Sign both finalists
choices.result: Two new prospects. One throws furniture. The other hides. Both have 500,000 followers.

choices.label: Sign only the winner
choices.result: One contract, one runner-up who now has a YouTube channel about 'being robbed'.

scenes.text: Season two is greenlit if you agree to 'more drama'. Their notes: 'more alcohol, more exes, one contestant who is secretly a spy'.
scenes.speaker: Network producer Kendra

choices.label: Agree to everything
choices.result: The spy contestant is real. Nobody knows for whom.

choices.label: Make it about the fighting
choices.result: A show about fighting. Novel. Critics love it. Fewer people watch.

scenes.text: RECALL NOTICE: BOSS JUICE 'Knockout Grape' has been found to contain 'significantly more caffeine than legally possible'. Reported side effects: tremors, visions, and in one case 'seeing through time'.
scenes.title: FOOD SAFETY AGENCY

choices.label: Issue a full recall and refunds ({$fee})
choices.result: Recalled. The cans become collectors' items. A full can sells for $400 online.

choices.label: Rebrand it as 'BOSS JUICE EXTREME'
choices.result: The rebrand is a hit until a fan runs through a wall. The wall is fine. The fan sues.

scenes.text: {sponsor.name} is furious that your own energy drink is being promoted in the same cage as their energy drink. They want exclusivity or they walk.
scenes.speaker: {sponsor.name} rep

choices.label: Drop your own drink from the cage
choices.result: Their logo stays. Your face comes off the cans in the arena. A small personal loss.

choices.label: Drop them
choices.result: BOSS JUICE: the only energy drink in the cage.
